result:
`platforms/` is gitignored as expected — good, build artifacts won't get committed.

## Summary

Implemented Section 4 (Health/HealthKit) per SPEC.md:

- **`App_Resources/iOS/Info.plist`** — added `NSHealthShareUsageDescription` / `NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription` (required or HealthKit calls crash).
- **`App_Resources/iOS/app.entitlements`** (new) — `com.apple.developer.healthkit` capability, correctly picked up by NativeScript's build and merged into the code-signing entitlements.
- **`types/references.d.ts`** — added a reference to the HealthKit `.d.ts` from `@nativescript/types-ios`, since the project's default type reference chain (`common.d.ts`) excludes HealthKit (it's only pulled in via the broader `ios.d.ts`).
- **`app/components/Health.vue`** — wired to `HKHealthStore` directly (no third-party wrapper, per spec §2):
  - `authorizationStatusForType` drives the three exact status strings, refreshed via the Page's `navigatedTo` event.
  - `Request Access` calls `requestAuthorizationToShareTypesReadTypesCompletion` for read+write step count.
  - `Log 500 Steps` saves an `HKQuantitySample` (500 steps, start=end=now) and reloads the list on success.
  - Last 7 Days uses `HKStatisticsCollectionQuery` with daily buckets and `CumulativeSum` to sum all sources per day, formatted as `Fri Jul 25 — 1,000 steps`, with today's row suffixed ` (today)`.
  - All HealthKit completion callbacks are marshaled back to the UI thread via `Utils.dispatchToMainThread`; errors surface as text in the status line.

`ns build ios` succeeds, and `vue-tsc --noEmit` reports zero type errors.
